countries_thin_or_null: Afghanistan — statistical system heavily constrained post-2021; primary domestic edges limited to NSIA–DAB data flows and SNA framework metadata; most series now internationally sourced or dormant
Yemen — national accounts uncompiled since 2014; dual institutional fragmentation; only historical SNA methodology metadata recoverable; no live domestic wiring among listed nodes

Sudan — wartime collapse of CBS site and state fiscal transparency; one confirmed CBOS–CBS CPI data flow (already noted in prior draft); Resource-Sharing Law citation too nonspecific for 2005 constitution link
Somalia — federal/FMS fragmentation; one solid COICOP methodology edge for national CPI; Puntland budget archive and FGS fiscal papers lack explicit cross-citations to listed statistical nodes

dependencies.basis: IMF e-GDDS DQAF metadata for Afghanistan National Accounts states that estimates broadly follow the concepts, definitions, and classifications of the System of National Accounts 1993 (SNA 1993), with some 1968 SNA features retained due to data constraints.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Statistical Framework: Currently, the national accounts estimates broadly follow the concepts, definitions, and classifications of the System of National Accounts 1993 (SNA 1993), as the basic data availability permit. However, based on current state of basic data, analytical and policy needs, and resources available for implementation, 1968 SNA concepts are applied in most cases.

dependencies.basis: IMF e-GDDS DQAF metadata for Afghanistan National Accounts states that basic data for the finance, insurance and real estate sector are provided by Da Afghanistan Bank (DAB) in aggregated form for central bank and commercial banks operations.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Finance, insurance, and real estate Basic data are provided by DAB in aggregated form for central bank and commercial banks operations. In-house surveys are conducted for money service providers including money changers and lenders.

dependencies.basis: IMF e-GDDS DQAF metadata for Yemen National Accounts states that definitions and concepts mainly follow the 1993 SNA, with some 1968 SNA features still employed.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The definitions and concepts of Yemen national accounts mainly follow the 1993 SNA, but a number of features of the 1968 SNA are still employed. Value added by industrial activity is calculated as gross production less intermediate consumption. GDP by expenditure category is calculated as the sum of the final use of goods and services through final consumption, gross capital formation, and exports less imports.

dependencies.basis: Central Bank of Sudan Economic and Financial Statistical Review (Q4 2024) Table 24 explicitly sources its Consumer Price Index and inflation rates from the Central Bureau of Statistics.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Table No. (24), "Consumer Price Index & Inflation Rates / Base Year 2007=100 ... Source: Central Bureau of Statistics." The Inflation rate decreased from 215.5% by the end of September 2024 to 187.8% by the end December of 2024.

dependencies.basis: Somalia National Bureau of Statistics CPI Methodological Note (May 2025) states the transition from COICOP 1999 to the latest COICOP 2018 classification for the modernized national CPI basket and weights.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Transitioning from COICOP 1999 to the latest COICOP 2018 classification. COICOP 2018 introduces more detailed consumption categories, including a fourth level (subclass) for granular analysis, expands divisions from twelve to thirteen by splitting Insurance and Financial Services and Personal Care and Miscellaneous Goods... A total of 537 items from the SIHBS were classified according to the 9-digit COICOP 2018 structure, and over 1,300 items in the CPI basket were realigned with new COICOP codes.
